honours.match: Match each award to what it honours.

rows.label: Ballon d'Or
rows.hook: is handed out by a French magazine to the world's finest footballer, once limited to Europeans

rows.label: Academy Awards
rows.hook: is nicknamed after a golden statuette and caps Hollywood's prize season with a televised ceremony

rows.label: Emmy Award
rows.hook: is given in separate ceremonies for primetime and daytime programming in America

rows.label: Heisman Trophy
rows.description: annual award for outstanding college football player
rows.hook: is presented each December to the top gridiron star at the university level

rows.label: Grammy Awards
rows.description: American award for achievements in music
rows.hook: is a gilded gramophone trophy handed out at a big annual ceremony for songs and albums

rows.label: Nobel Prize
rows.description: set of annual international awards, primarily 5 established in 1895 by Alfred Nobel
rows.hook: was set up in the will of the man who invented dynamite

rows.label: Golden Raspberry Awards
rows.description: award presented in recognition of the worst in film
rows.hook: is a parody ceremony whose trophy is a golf-ball-sized berry mounted on a reel

rows.label: Tony Awards
rows.description: awards to recognize the excellence in live Broadway theatre, presented by the American Theatre Wing and The Broadway League at an annual ceremony in New York City
rows.hook: is presented each June at a Manhattan ceremony for stage productions and performances

rows.label: British Academy Film Awards
rows.description: annual award show hosted by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts
rows.hook: is held in London and gives winners a statuette shaped like a theatrical mask

rows.label: Golden Globe Awards
rows.description: American film and television awards in several categories (1944–)
rows.hook: is held each January as a lead-up to the Oscars

rows.label: Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards
rows.hook: gives winners a hollow orange blimp figurine
